modalities.evidence: Multi-distance fNIRS recordings from 12 healthy adults

output.population: 12 healthy young adults (6 female, 6 male; 23.2 ± 5.2 years; range 18–37 years)
output.summary: Multi-distance fNIRS recordings from healthy young adults during resting state, ball-squeezing tasks, and a motion-artifact induction task, released openly to support diffuse optical tomography and motion-artifact methods work.
